mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling supply chain disruptions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 58% of instances with 2mo consecutive INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a high RSAFS (above $700B) indicates strong demand for housing, a leading indicator for overall economic demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising FEDFUNDS and a low CPIAUCSL (below 320) inflation rate creates a 'sweet spot' for monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 52% of 'sweet spot' instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in 2 months, indicating labor market stress, investors become cautious, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE rising > 0.5pp in 2mo, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month moving average of HOUST above 1200 indicates sustained housing market strength, a proxy for overall demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with 3mo MA HOUST above 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
